conventions.units: CSS pixels. x and y are relative to the parent layer; "abs" values in get_tree are page coordinates.
conventions.autoLayout: Children of an auto layout frame are positioned by the layout; their x/y are ignored. Use sizing "fill"/"hug" and layout gap/padding/align instead.
conventions.instances: Layers inside an instance can only take overrides (text, fill, stroke, visible). Edit the main component to change structure.
conventions.undo: Every mutating call is one undo step labelled "AI · <tool>". batch runs several calls as one step.
conventions.references: Inside batch, "$0", "$1"... refer to the id returned by an earlier step.

spec.types: frame, group, component, instance, rect, image, ellipse, polygon, star, line, arrow, vector, text, boolean
spec.common: name, x, y, w, h (numbers; or w/h "hug"/"fill"), rotation, visible, locked, opacity (0–1), blend ("multiply"…), children (frames, groups, components, booleans)
spec.paint: fill / stroke: "#RRGGBB" | "#RRGGBBAA" | {type:"linear", angle:90, stops:[[0,"#fff"],[1,"#000"]]} | {type:"radial", stops} | {type:"image", src:"data:image/png;base64,…", fit:"fill|fit|stretch|tile"} | an array of these (bottom first) | null to clear
spec.stroke: strokeWidth, strokeAlign ("inside" | "center" | "outside"), dash ([dash, gap] or 0), strokeCap, strokeJoin
spec.effects: effects: [{type:"drop-shadow", x, y, blur, spread, color}, {type:"inner-shadow", …}, {type:"blur", blur}]  (shorthands: shadow: {...}, blur: 8)
spec.shape: radius (number or [tl,tr,br,bl]) for rect/frame; points + innerRadius for polygon/star; path (SVG path data) for vector; from/to [x,y] for line/arrow; startMarker/endMarker ("arrow" | "triangle" | "circle")
spec.image: type "image" with image: "data:image/…" (or an https URL that allows CORS), imageFit
spec.text: text, font {family, size, weight (100–900 or "bold"), lineHeight ("auto" | px | "150%"), letterSpacing, italic}, color, textAlign (left|center|right), verticalAlign, textCase (upper|lower|title), decoration (underline|strikethrough). Text hugs its content unless you set w.
spec.autoLayout: layout: {mode:"row"|"column"|"none", gap: number | "auto" (space between), padding: n | [v,h] | [t,r,b,l], align: start|center|end, crossAlign: start|center|end}; on children: sizing {w:"fixed|hug|fill", h:…}, absolute: true to opt out
spec.frame: clip (default true), constraints {h:"left|right|left-right|center|scale", v:"top|bottom|top-bottom|center|scale"} for children of non-auto-layout frames
spec.components: type "instance" with component: "<id or name>" and overrides: {"<child layer name>": {text, fill, visible}}; components take description
spec.styles: fillStyle / strokeStyle / textStyle: style name or id

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Start here. Returns the app version, the conventions (units, coordinates, colors), the full layer spec reference, and every tool with its input schema.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: File overview: pages, the current page, components, styles, selection and viewport.

tools.name: get_tree
tools.description: Layer tree as specs. Without node_id returns the current page's top-level layers. Use depth to limit size; deeper layers report childCount.

node_id.description: Layer id (from get_tree, find_nodes or get_selection)

page_id.description: Page to read (defaults to the current page)

format.description: spec = JSON (default); outline = indented text, cheapest on tokens

include_images.description: Embed image data URLs (large). Default false: images are returned as asset refs.

tools.name: get_nodes
tools.description: Full spec for specific layers, including all children.

tools.name: find_nodes
tools.description: Search layers by name or text content (case-insensitive substring), optionally filtered by type. Searches the current page unless all_pages is true.

query.description: Substring of the layer name or text

type.description: frame, text, rect, ellipse, vector, group, component, instance, …

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: What the designer has selected right now, as specs.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Main components you can instantiate with create {"type":"instance","component":"<id or name>"}.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Color and text styles. Apply with fillStyle / strokeStyle / textStyle in a spec.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Render pixels so you can see the design. target: a layer id, "selection", "page" or "viewport" (default). Over ninja-p2p the image arrives as a file in your inbox; elsewhere it is returned as base64.

max_size.description: Longest side in pixels (default 1024; use 512 to save tokens)

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export layers in an AI- or developer-friendly format. html = standalone HTML+CSS (auto layout becomes flexbox); spec = round-trippable JSON for create; outline = indented text; tokens = design tokens (DTCG JSON + CSS variables); svg; png/jpg = base64 (or a file over ninja-p2p).

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create one layer (with nested children) from a spec. Returns the new id and the ids of every created layer by name path. Frames get a white fill unless you pass fill.

spec.description: Layer spec — see get_capabilities.spec for every field. Minimum: {"type":"rect"}.

parent_id.description: Parent frame/group/component (defaults to the current page)

index.description: Stacking position inside the parent (0 = bottom; default = top)

tools.name: update
tools.description: Change properties on existing layers using spec fields (only the fields you pass change). Works on several layers at once with ids.

id.description: Layer id (from get_tree, find_nodes or get_selection)

props.description: Spec fields to change, e.g. {"fill":"#E5484D","radius":8} or {"text":"New label"}

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete layers (and everything inside them).

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move layers into another parent and/or to a stacking position. Keeps their position on the page unless the new parent uses auto layout.

parent_id.description: Layer id (from get_tree, find_nodes or get_selection)

tools.name: duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate layers in place (top-level frames are placed to the right).

tools.name: group
tools.description: Group layers (they must share a parent).

tools.name: ungroup
tools.description: Ungroup groups, boolean groups or frames, keeping their children.

tools.name: wrap_in_frame
tools.description: Wrap layers in a new frame. Pass auto_layout: true to get an auto layout frame whose direction and gap are inferred from the layers.

tools.name: boolean
tools.description: Combine shapes with a boolean operation (the result stays editable).

tools.name: flatten
tools.description: Flatten shapes, booleans or groups into one vector path.

tools.name: mask
tools.description: Use the bottom-most layer as a mask for the others (they are grouped).

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Turn a frame or group into a main component, or wrap several layers in a new component.

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Turn instances back into plain frames.

tools.name: reset_overrides
tools.description: Clear all overrides on an instance.

id.description: Layer id (from get_tree, find_nodes or get_selection)

tools.name: align
tools.description: Align layers to each other (or a single layer to its parent).

tools.name: distribute
tools.description: Space three or more layers evenly.

tools.name: reorder
tools.description: Change stacking order.

tools.name: import_svg
tools.description: Import SVG markup as editable vector layers.

parent_id.description: Layer id (from get_tree, find_nodes or get_selection)

tools.name: create_style
tools.description: Create a color style (value = paint) or text style (value = font object).

value.description: Paint for color styles; {family,size,weight,lineHeight,letterSpacing} for text styles

tools.name: pages
tools.description: Create, rename, switch to, or delete pages.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Set the designer's selection (and optionally zoom to it) so they can see what you are talking about.

tools.name: view
tools.description: Move the designer's viewport: zoom to fit the page, to layers, or set zoom.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change (yours or the designer's).

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show a short message to the designer (and log it in the AI panel).

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several tool calls in order as ONE undo step. Later steps can use "$0", "$1"… (or "$0.created.<path>") to refer to ids from earlier results. Stops at the first error and rolls everything back.
